name: Condemnation
overview: Scripture reveals that condemnation is the just sentence of God against sin, yet He mercifully redeems His servants and does not deal with them according to their iniquities, as seen in Psalms 34:22 and 103:10. God's lovingkindness continually preserves those who trust in Him (Psalms 40:11), and He promises to blot out transgressions for His own sake (Isaiah 43:25). Despite this mercy, unrepentant cities faced rebuke for their unbelief and refusal to repent (Matthew 11:20), highlighting the inseparable consequence of sin and the necessity of repentance for deliverance from condemnation.
